firstPlayerRule: The last player to visit an abandoned mine in a rusty wagon oozing coal residue takes the Caller token and starts; alternatively, choose by any method.
clarifications: The first player draws four starting cards, the second five, the third six and the fourth seven.
internalEvidence: Rendered PDF page 2, printed page 3, gives the deliberately specific criterion, official open-choice alternative, Caller token and unequal opening hands. Page 8 credits Sylex Edition ©2022. Roadmaps and Reward Chart match inventory BGG 366397. SHA-256: 20003d906cc6abc4584d977b255f9e5173cc10c2b6d7339a3f4773c9e8c01f68. Owner authorized assistant review on 2026-09-22. Editorial review 2026-09-24: Rechecked the opening instruction, game identity and named edition against the rendered rulebook.
uncertainty: No tie procedure is given if the mine-visit method is used.
